scores.visual_critic_note: Restrained monochromatic blue palette and cohesive dark theme feel deliberately designed, but 9px network node labels and tiny color-scatter axis text push the readability floor hard at rendered size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Strong encoding integrity: scaleSqrt used correctly for both network node and color dot size, bar chart y-domain anchored at zero with data-driven max, all scale domains derived from data extents, no dual axes or KDE deception — minor deduction for the block list bypassing D3 keyed joins (innerHTML) and the color view's fixed hue/lightness axes being semantically appropriate but not verified against actual data range.
scores.stress_test_note: The dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly coalesces canvas redraws, but the expensive BitFilter bitmask computation and bitFilter.filtered() AND-fold still run un-throttled on every mousemove during brush interactions, exposing main-thread jank at 60fps for 34k records.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views stay within working memory limits, the pre-computed (non-live) force layout avoids animation noise, and the monochromatic network keeps color overload contained, but tracking filter state across all four panels simultaneously — timeline brush, network click, color brush, thumbnail toggle — pushes the upper bound of what a user can hold in working memory without losing their place.
